Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/pull/1#issuecomment-6124420137 ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added commands to import GitHub review findings, record verdicts, check review-round completion for a specific PR revision, and search past decisions. * Findings retain their source context and update safely on re-import. Verdicts can optionally be applied to GitHub threads. * **Bug Fixes** * Improved handling of informational bot notices and discovery of relevant review precedents. * **Documentation** * Added setup, command, and review-workflow guidance. * **Quality** * Added automated checks for builds, tests, coverage, package installation, and releases. ## Walkthrough The change adds the `pm-review` extension for GitHub finding imports, verdicts, precedent searches, and exact-head round checks. It also adds package quality gates, CI and release workflows, documentation, and PM workspace settings and project records. ### Changes **Review extension** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Review types and extension entry**
`src/types.ts`, `index.ts`, `manifest.json`, `README.md`|Defines review-domain types, exports and activates the extension, and documents its commands and behavior.| |**GitHub snapshots and transport**
`src/github.ts`, `test/github.test.ts`, `test/fixtures/*`, `test/helpers.ts`|Adds paginated GitHub snapshots, contribution and check mapping, viewer lookup, and thread mutations. Tests exercise recorded and synthetic responses.| |**Finding classification and tracker import**
`src/findings.ts`, `src/tracker.ts`, `test/core.test.ts`, `README.md`|Classifies bot contributions, persists imported findings while preserving existing verdicts, and searches fix and refuse precedents.| |**Verdicts, round receipts, and commands**
`src/verdict.ts`, `src/round.ts`, `src/commands.ts`, `test/core.test.ts`, `README.md`|Adds local verdict recording and optional thread actions, exact-head completion checks, and four review commands.| **Package quality and delivery** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Package setup and quality gates**
`package.json`, `scripts/*`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`, `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, `test/tooling.test.ts`, `test/install.acceptance.ts`, `tsconfig*.json`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`|Adds package configuration, validation scripts, CI and CodeQL workflows, dependency automation, and npm/Bun packed-install checks.| |**Verified release workflow**
`.github/workflows/release.yml`, `.github/approved-git-identities.txt`, `.github/identity-baseline.txt`|Adds gated release preparation, artifact validation, provenance-backed publishing, tag checks, release resumption, and Bun acceptance.| **PM workspace and project records** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Workspace settings and repository configuration**
`.agents/pm/settings.json`, `.agents/pm/schema/*`, `.gitattributes`, `.gitignore`|Adds PM settings and status/workflow schemas, merge-driver mappings, and runtime ignore rules.| |**Review project tracking records**
`.agents/pm/epics/*`, `.agents/pm/features/*`, `.agents/pm/issues/*`, `.agents/pm/history/*`|Adds project records for review work, follow-up issues, acceptance criteria, linked files and tests, and progress receipts.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~60 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant ReviewCommand participant GitHubTransport participant findingsOf participant importFindings participant PmClient ReviewCommand->>GitHubTransport: snapshot(repo, pr) GitHubTransport-->>ReviewCommand: PullRequest snapshot ReviewCommand->>findingsOf: classify bot contributions findingsOf-->>ReviewCommand: Finding list ReviewCommand->>importFindings: import findings importFindings->>PmClient: create or update ReviewFinding items ```
Merge Risk: 🟡 Moderate · up to dda1d
The review extension itself looks sound. Two delivery problems should be fixed before merging. First, the release workflow can fail at the packaging step on npm 10. Second, a single large commit would permanently break the identity check in CI. A smaller issue also affects running the coverage gate with a relative path.
